evals.prompt: Our sell-through on last season's line is really soft and I don't know where to start.
evals.expected_output: Should match to the lift-sell-through route in ROUTES.yaml and return the full chain (range-review, discount-and-clearance, commercial-ops, visual-merchandising) in order, name the owner (Campaign Manager), flag the Tier 2 gate at markdown depth, and state the metric (sell-through velocity, GMROI, promotional yield target >60%) — not just point at the first skill in the chain.
assertions: Matches to the lift-sell-through route rather than a generic clearance answer
Returns the full ordered chain, not just one skill
States the owner role and the Tier 2 gate before any work starts
States the metric the route is measured on

evals.prompt: How do I get our TikTok ad copy to sound punchier?
evals.expected_output: Should recognize this is not an outcome-shaped request but a request for a specific skill (ad-creative or copywriting), and say so — pointing directly at the closest matching skill rather than forcing it into a ROUTES.yaml route it doesn't fit.
assertions: Does not force this into an existing ROUTES.yaml route
Recognizes the user already effectively knows which skill they want
Points at ad-creative or copywriting directly

evals.prompt: I want to reduce CAC and also improve our promotional yield — which matters more right now?
evals.expected_output: Should recognize two candidate routes both plausibly fit (reduce-cac and improve-promotional-yield), and apply CONFLICT.md's resolution order — cite marketing-strategy.md Section 12's ranked priorities first to settle which matters more this cycle, rather than picking one arbitrarily or running both simultaneously without a stated reason.
assertions: Identifies both routes as plausible candidates
Applies the CONFLICT.md resolution order rather than guessing
Cites Section 12 (Strategic Priorities) as the first tiebreaker
Does not silently pick one route without explaining why

evals.prompt: We need to improve our influencer program's ROI specifically for our Gen Z segment on Discord communities.
evals.expected_output: Should recognize no existing route in ROUTES.yaml matches this specific outcome, say so plainly, and suggest the closest single existing skill (influencer-marketing or community-marketing) rather than forcing a weak match to an unrelated route. Should not fabricate a route that doesn't exist in the file.
assertions: States plainly that no route matches rather than forcing one
Suggests the closest existing skill by name
Does not invent or fabricate a route not present in ROUTES.yaml
